## Issue and one outcome

Closes #<issue-number>

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and why this diff is one reviewable unit.

## Validation and limitations

List checks actually run and their results. State remaining risks or unverified behavior.

## Review record

Add the submitted GitHub review link and reviewed head SHA before merging.
Disclose an agent review posted through the author account; it is not an
independent GitHub account approval. Re-review if the head changes.

## Completion

- [ ] The issue predates implementation and defines acceptance checks.
- [ ] Commits are coherent; unrelated outcomes have separate issues and PRs.
- [ ] Acceptance checks and required CI pass.
- [ ] Blocking review findings are resolved; the recorded review matches the final head.
- [ ] Commit attribution is verified or its limitation is reported.
- [ ] Merge is authorized and repository protections are respected.
